anchors.anchor: It’s as plain as the disappearing ink on this notecard.
They can take fingerprints, or do forensics, or something.
Listen, that bus comes out of nowhere.
My name, the date, and my exact freaking age were there.
I knew there was something off about him.
I have to take this notecard to the police.
My eyes must be playing tricks on me.
